## Goal

Close the loop the refreshed scans opened: each newly surfaced finding gets a
disposition (accepted-with-reason / scheduled / false-positive-with-evidence),
and the milestones one honest gap - traces are not implemented - is written
down as a limitation in the two places a reviewer looks, rather than being
implied by a directory that contains a commented collector.

## Acceptance criteria

Four fenced commands, each a deterministic single `bash -c` one-liner with
exactly two single quotes, no heredoc, no backtick, pure ASCII, run from the
repository root. The python probes travel as base64 literals materialised
into a `mktemp -d` scratch directory and are removed by the fence itself.
Every fence REDs loudly if `python3` is missing - a skipped probe proves
nothing. Each probe pins the BASE and PREDECESSOR shas internally, so a fence
cannot be made green by pointing it at a different commit.

### ac1 - the register loop is closed against the REFRESHED reports (anchor-count integrity, tree-robust)

```bash
bash -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac1 RED: python3 is missing - a skipped probe proves nothing about a refreshed tree, so this fence fails loudly instead of skipping"; exit 1; }; D=$(mktemp -d); printf "%s" "" | base64 -d > "$D/t87_common.py" || { echo "ac1 RED: the pinned t87_common.py could not be materialised - report it, never edit the fence"; rm -rf "$D"; exit 1; }; printf "%s" "" | base64 -d > "$D/t87_ac1_probe.py" || { echo "ac1 RED: the pinned t87_ac1_probe.py could not be materialised - report it, never edit the fence"; rm -rf "$D"; exit 1; }; python3 "$D/t87_ac1_probe.py" "$PWD" || { echo "ac1 RED: the probe exited non-zero - its own ac1 RED lines above name the failing leg"; rm -rf "$D"; exit 1; }; rm -rf "$D"; echo "ac1 GREEN: THE LOOP IS CLOSED AGAINST THE REFRESHED REPORTS - the anchor and the committed reports agree on every count and the gitleaks suffix set, the loop set re-derived live is fully bound in the register, no register row references an absent finding, all five count rows equal the freshly measured counts, every gitleaks fingerprint is dispositioned, and no stale zero-prose survives (see the ac1 evidence lines above)"'
```

- Anchor integrity first: the anchors per-tool `findings` must equal the
  counts freshly parsed from the committed reports, and its
  `finding_id_loop.{base,refreshed,new_ids,gone_ids}` must equal the sets

## Constraints (hard)

- The product delta is EXACTLY TWO paths: `security/agent-security-notes.md`,
  `security/ai-tool-data-policy.md` (plus this cards own room: the card, its
  mirror, the handoff, `t87_scratch/`).
- The register is bound to MEASURED findings. A disposition may not be written
  for a finding that does not exist in the refreshed reports, and a finding may
  not be dropped from the register because it is inconvenient.
- The five reports, the t86 anchor, the t41 gate generator, `Makefile`, the
  criterion doc, `docs/config.yaml`, `observability/`,
  `incident-response/`, `ops/`, `backend/`, `frontend/`, `.github/`,
  `openapi.yaml` (FROZEN), `README.md`, `docs/criteria/*` and
  `docs/backlog.md` are never touched by this card. `ops/diagnosis.md` stays
  ADD-ONLY against the t41 gate - and this card does not need it.
- `security/ai-tool-data-policy.md` is ADD-ONLY versus BASE (ac3 proves the
  prefix); the notes file is edited only in the three disclosed places: the
  register intro prose (the stale zero-claim), the five count rows, the new
  register rows, and the limitations table (append + the intro count word).
- No scan mechanism, tool version or allowlist change (that is t86s frozen
  boundary); no re-running any scanner; the reports are INPUTS of this card.
- No claim of remediation. This card dispositions; it does not fix, and it
  must not describe a fix that was not made. A gitleaks hit is closed as a
  false positive ONLY with its matched construct named, never in bulk.
- The traces statement must match t75s commented compose block and t77s
  collector header exactly - the card shows the three-way agreement rather
  than asserting it.
- The t41 gate rows stay RED by design (stale `EXPECTED_*` literals belong to
  the later generator-owning card); this card closes the REGISTER, not the
  generator, and says so in the register rather than hiding it.

## Out of scope

- Regenerating `docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md` or re-pinning the
  t41 generators `EXPECTED_REPORT_ROWS`/`EXPECTED_LOOP_IDS` - the later
  gate-owning card does that, and ac4 refuses this card from doing it.
- Enabling tracing, the otel/loki/tempo block, or any `observability/` edit -
  this card RECORDS the limitation; building the pipeline would be a different
  card with its own criterion.
- Remediation of any finding (dependency bumps, shell=True rewrites, lockfile
  churn); the dispositions say what a later window does, this card does not
  do it here.
- t88s scan summary, t89s evidence map: they consume this register, they are
  not edited by it.
- Any CI wiring, any new scanner, any new tool version, any new REQ-ID.
